releaseNotes:
🚀 First official release of EdgeDock (Smart Popup Tools) by StrawHats Studios.

✨ Features:
- Smart Edge Dock sidebar with floating overlay
- Assistive touch controller & quick tools
- RAM Booster, Volume & Brightness fine control
- Custom neon glow themes & dock positioning
- Full offline-first design with Start.io ad support
- GitHub OTA updates integration
